correctness.rationale: For odd p,n>=2 the tame mu_{2(p-1)} quotient of y^p-y=xR(x) has one infinity place. Invariant monomial basis 1,x^{2(p-1)-2b}y^b over k[x^{2(p-1)}] has distinct pole residue classes p+bL mod p; thus it yields exactly H=<p,p+L,...,p+(p-1)L>. Standard Apéry arithmetic gives genus (p-1)(L+1)/2=(p^{2n}-1)/4, conductor, type, Riemann-Roch dimensions and gap weight (p^2-1)(L^2-1)/24. Independent gap enumeration verified p,n=(3,2),(3,3),(5,2),(7,2), including weights 120,10920,5928,79200. Infinite result follows from the actual ring proof, not these tests.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not replace all-parameter reasoning.

originality.rationale: The 2026-11-02 general theorem for C_f:u v^p-v=f(u) with p∤deg(f)-1 implies this semigroup exactly. Choose a nonzero alpha with alpha^(p-1)=-1 and put v=alpha*t; then u t^p-t=-f_special(u)/alpha and deg f_special=(p^{2n}-1)/(2(p-1))=L+1 with p∤L. The prior theorem yields the identical minimal generators, Apéry set, conductor, type and genus for ALL polynomials of that degree, thus dominates this constrained maximal-curve family. Weierstrass weight and bounded one-point dimensions are immediate universal semigroup/gap formulas and not an independent structural theorem.
residual_risks: The original maximal-curve paper full text was not obtained, but the stronger prior semigroup theorem provides decisive coverage independent of that access.
